minutes.headline: Select Board recommended most Town Meeting articles but deferred several, including bylaws, salary schedule, flag petition
minutes.summary: The board heard a food pantry update, made appointments and ratifications, and approved licenses and the emergency management plan. Most of the meeting went article by article through the draft Town Meeting warrant, recommending approval on most and deferring a handful for more information. Members also debated the ratification process and a new town facilities director position.

public_comment.topic: Urged considering unified town and school facilities leadership before hiring a new town facilities director, given vacancies in DPW director and school facilities director.
Publicly thanked the fire chief and staff for saving her husband's life.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to recommend approval of most Town Meeting warrant articles, including the FY23 budget, stabilization transfers, and enterprise funds.
The board deferred its recommendation on several articles: salary schedule, personnel bylaw, general bylaws, sewer bylaw, marijuana zoning, sewer service petition, and state flag resolution.
Article 17 on cemetery lots was deferred 3-1 over concern about a memorial on private property, with the chair voting no.
The board accepted a revised emergency management plan and approved a Shriners toll booth fundraiser and two business licenses.
The board made appointments and ratified seasonal hires, and set meetings for April 26 and May 3 before Town Meeting.

why_it_matters: The warrant articles the board recommended, including the FY23 budget and the stabilization transfers, are what residents will be asked to vote on at Town Meeting.
The deferred bylaw, salary schedule and zoning articles have no board recommendation yet, so residents have less guidance on them before Town Meeting.
watch_next: Select Board meetings on April 26 and May 3, before Town Meeting on the 7th, where deferred articles may get recommendations.
The town manager's current and proposed salary schedules, requested for comparison before the board recommends on Article 21.
